subject: table: Fixed concurrent pk update with global index during truncate partition (#63832)
summary: Reviewed only this commit vs its first parent, focusing on table behavior. The change in `pkg/table/tables/index.go` adjusts the unique global-index create path during `TRUNCATE PARTITION` in `StateDeleteReorganization` to read the mem-buffer first (preserving tombstone semantics) and only then do a non-lazy snapshot read, preventing `DupKeyCheckLazy` from incorrectly setting `kv.SetPresumeKeyNotExists` for keys already deleted/overwritten within the same txn (e.g., PK update implemented as delete+add) and allowing the intended overwrite/locking behavior. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; later `upstream/master` retains the same logic (only refactors around helpers).
